preconditions.description: Number of employees is between 1 and 100,000.
Number of dislike pairs is between 0 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n and a_i != b_i for a_i, b_i in dislike_pairs)
preconditions.description: Each dislike pair consists of two distinct employees within the range.
Number of salary revisions is between 0 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v_i <= n for v_i in salary_revisions)
preconditions.description: Each salary revision involves an employee within the range.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in output)
postconditions.description: Each element in the output is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= n * (n - 1) * (n - 2) // 6 for x in output)
postconditions.description: Each element in the output is a non-negative integer representing the number of dangerous triples.
